name: Choubatsu Yobikou Zenryousei
original_name: 懲罰予備校 全凌制
source:
This school is of dark nature. It deals in sex slave training in exchange for generous donations. Main character is fired from the previous school and has trouble finding work with such background. But this school accepts his candidacy as efficiency is evaluated here the most.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
這所學校的內幕很黑暗：它以豐厚捐款為交換，調教性奴。主角被前一所學校解僱，帶著這樣的背景很難找到工作。但這所學校錄取了他，因為這裡最看重的是效率。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
